outcome: umbilical cord blood gas values (pH, PCO2, HCO3, PO2, base excess, fetal hemoglobin)
cohort: Pregnant women at term with normal pregnancies and obstetric resolutions without evidence of fetal distress, delivering either vaginally or by elective cesarean at the Hospital Espanol of Mexico (Maternidad Mundet).
finding: Umbilical cord blood gas values in this cohort were pH 7.34, PCO2 39.3081, HCO3 20.66, PO2 29.3529, base excess -4.09, and fetal hemoglobin 15.18, with no statistically significant differences compared to studies conducted at lower altitudes.
